notes:
Console 2.3.40. Teacher marks now turn up on the marks grid.
- The grid has a Term selector: marks sent for another term were saved but never shown, so this was the usual reason. They are now one tap away
- Marks a teacher sends are matched to this school's own learners, subjects, assessments and terms before saving, so a phone whose term or subject was recreated no longer sends marks into ids the console never uses
- Teacher submissions are only cleared from the cloud when every one of them imported; a partial import used to delete the rest
- Anything that cannot be matched is reported instead of being silently stored
